plan: Initialize Day 0 balance by subtracting setup costs for Options A, B, and C from the initial cash of 11,000 USD.
Execute a day-by-day iterative loop from Day 1 to Day 42, deducting daily service and fuel costs for each option.
Integrate scheduled cash events (Day 14 collection, Day 28 overhead, Day 35 collection) into the daily trajectory, calculating balances both pre- and post-event.
Monitor and record the minimum cash balance reached for each option to verify if it drops below the 2,500 USD threshold.
Calculate the final Day 42 closing balance for all three options to determine liquidity outcomes.
evidence_to_validate: Initial cash and minimum cash threshold (CASE42-V1)
Daily operating costs and setup fees for Options A, B, and C (CASE42-V1)
Scheduled cash event dates and amounts (CASE42-V1)
output.method: Iterative daily ledger simulation using the specified order of operations: daily costs first, then event-based adjustments.
